mapper.select: /* logInqyDao1010 : 로그 시퀀스 조회 */ SELECT 'LOG_' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(REPLACE(LOG_ID,'LOG_')),0) + 1,4,0) AS SEQUENCE_ID FROM LOG

/* logInqyDao1030 : 로그 상세 조회 */ SELECT L.LOG_ID , L.LOGTYPE_CD , CC_LOG.COMMCODE_NM AS LOGTYPE_NM , L.EMP_IDX , E.EMP_ID , E.EMP_NM , O.ORG_NM , L.MAPPING_ID , L.IP_ADDR , L.IS_SUCC , L.LOG_MSG , L.REG_DT , L.REG_TM FROM LOG L LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO E ON L.EMP_IDX = E.EMP_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG O ON O.ORG_CD = E.ORG_CD AND O.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN RANK R ON R.RANK_CD = E.RANK_CD AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN COMMCODE CC_LOG ON CC_LOG.COMMCODE_CD = L.LOGTYPE_CD WHERE L.LOG_ID = #{sequenceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
